reports.work_planned: Set and grout the replacement pump, then protect the grout during its specified cure.

reports.materials_equipment: Pump setting tools, lifting frame, cementitious precision grout

reports.schedule_status: Physical pump setting and grouting are complete after the earlier deferrals. Grout cure is proceeding to the specified release time. reports.supporting_evidence: Grout batch sheet GB-P6-12 and preliminary alignment sheet AL-P6-12; signed AT-P6-0912 sheet not linked

reports.work_planned: Terminate instruments on the adjacent service rack.

reports.materials_equipment: Pump setting tools, lifting frame, cementitious precision grout
